title: Title & Registration Services Submission Service Levels by Service Type
content:
Title Operations submits a Title & Registration Services packet to the state within the submission target of the order's service type, counted in business days from the day the order becomes ready to submit, and resubmits a cured order within the resubmission target, counted in business days from the day the rejected order becomes ready again.

| Service type | Submission target (business days) | Resubmission target (business days) | Submissions after which the order goes to the title escalations team | Purchase order must show insurance verified before submission | Title application waits until the purchase order is fully funded | Packet sent by mail to the buyer's county office | Dealer deadline treated as met when the delay came from documents returned after the document return period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | 5 | 3 | 3 | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | 3 | 3 | 3 | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | 3 | 3 | 3 | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | 7 | 5 | 3 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | 10 | 5 | 3 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | 5 | 5 | 3 | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |

"Fully funded" means the purchase order balance is zero or below. A service that does not send its packet by mail submits it electronically.

## Service level notes

- Kestrel Title-Only Service is the only service type whose packet does not wait for the purchase order to show insurance verified.
- Kestrel Out-of-State Registration and Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection send the packet by mail to the buyer's county office; the four other service types submit electronically.
- Every service type refers an order to the title escalations team once it has reached 3 submissions to the state.
- Hypothetical illustration: two orders become ready to submit on the same day, one under Kestrel In-State New Registration and one under Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection; the first carries a target of 3 business days from that day and the second a target of 10 business days.
